persona.title: Podcast listeners score suspiciously high on parasocial attachment
persona.why: Podcast listeners scoring high on parasocial attachment - and so do people who like novelty and good conversation, which undercuts the exotic reading. The measurement that makes the creator category ordinary.

character.title: He did not ask to be buried as Dracula
character.why: A man interred in his character's costume, where the costume's owner chose nothing at all: his son and mother decided. played-role because the entry is entirely about where a role ends and a person starts.

companion.title: Nobody in that room argues with him
companion.why: Believed present and unverifiable, which is the haunted test exactly - and the film's own mechanism is that nobody who could check declines to. Filed social-agent because he is addressed, not used.

divine.title: The wax masks in the hall
divine.why: A wax likeness of a specific dead relative, kept in the house and never able to answer. Same shelf as neanderthal-burial, and that is deliberate: burying a relative you intend to keep within reach and casting one are the same act at 70,000 years' remove.

institution.title: YouTube launches
institution.why: Uploads become trivially cheap and the audience begins to attach to individuals rather than channels. The moment the object changed shape, and it is the platform that did it.

cosmology.title: Nine to twelve million heard it
cosmology.why: Filed cosmology/scheduling - "a repeated slot that becomes a container for the tie" - because what this entry argues is a property of the hour rather than of the script.

officer.title: The coach
officer.why: An adult with authority over a child for years, remembered partly by how they made them feel at nine. The compulsory version of the same attachment as the teacher, and the entry that shows the category is about asymmetry of power rather than about proximity.

predator.title: Doxxing the person, not the character
predator.why: The jump from disliking a fictional portrayal to publishing a real person's address. The word had to be invented for a grievance that used to be settled by writing a letter, which is the shift in register the entry documents.
